statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ is holding near the reported session high after a strong European-morning rise, but repeated failed retracements are not yet established; expiration and the U.S. data/open cluster keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the blocking threshold, with the principal event-risk window concentrated around 13:00-14:30 UTC.
headline: NQ holds near session high; Tail stays WATCH ahead of expiration and U.S. data
body: Delayed December NQ was near 29,861.5 at 08:01 UTC, close to the reported session high of 29,862.75. European technology shares were firmer and oil was lower after the BOJ hike. The move is directional, but repeated failed retracements are not established, so Tail remains below the blocking threshold.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 hours, Tail moved from low into WATCH during Thursday's technology-led advance, briefly entered the blocking band twice, fell back to low after the cash close, then returned to WATCH during the BOJ decision and post-decision window.
outlookSummary: Current NQ high-hold keeps Tail at upper WATCH, while the main U.S. danger window is 13:00-14:30 UTC for Industrial Production, the cash open, Bowman, State Employment, the Leading Index and expiration flows. Blocking risk remains conditional on persistent one-way structure or failed retracements.
